title: Replaying 17 audited jobs under three server settings
compared: The baseline server, the same server with thinking turned off, and the Q4_K_M quantisation with 64 batch threads.
sample: 17 public jobs whose answers were audited by hand, each replayed with its three questions, one run per setting, on an aarch64 test VM.
verdict: Thinking off took 37% less time but got the class right for 9 instead of 13 jobs. Dropped. Q4_K_M with 64 batch threads took 37% less time with 12 classes right.
note: Where the audit gave no expected answer for a job, the answer counts as right. The time saved by 64 batch threads was later traced to the thread cap of the baseline server, not to the batch threads.
